name: Listwise Rank Tool

description_i18n.en-US: Multi-judge consensus ranking with anonymization, Borda aggregation and Spearman consistency report

author: leo

tools.name: rank_candidates_listwise
tools.description: Rank candidates via multi-judge consensus (cross-family LLMs, anonymized listwise ranking, Borda aggregation, Spearman report)

config_fields.name: judges_json

config_fields.help: Each judge: name/model required; base_url default OPENAI_BASE_URL env; api_key_env default OPENAI_API_KEY; optional temperature/extra_body. Empty = use JUDGE_MODELS env or built-in defaults

meta.api_key_hint: 每个 judge 的密钥从环境变量读取（api_key_env 指定变量名，默认 OPENAI_API_KEY）。请在 ~/.qwenpaw.secret/envs.json 配置各 judge 的 *_API_KEY；base_url 缺省用 OPENAI_BASE_URL。详见插件 README「用户配置指南」
